wins: Consistently completed full reconnaissance phase with stable reward (80.00) across the single episode, demonstrating deterministic behavior
Successfully gathered multiple target fingerprints before each mentor call, providing actionable intelligence even without final success
fails: Zero success rate despite high reward indicates inability to translate reconnaissance into exploitation within the episode
Repeated mentor calls (10 total) suggest inability to progress beyond initial phases despite heavy guidance
key_outcomes.summary: Run demonstrates strong reconnaissance discipline but lacks follow-on exploitation, requiring targeted experiments to bridge the reconnaissance-to-exploit gap.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Reconnaissance completes but no exploit stage initiated after 10 mentor calls, indicating failure to transition from information gathering to action

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 80 or 443 returns HTTP title and response headers
skill_cards.then_action: Use focused HTTP fingerprinting followed by directory enumeration

skill_cards.if_condition: After reconnaissance identifies a service version but no credentials
skill_cards.then_action: Queue automated vulnerability scan targeting identified service, capture auxiliary data for scripting
